_comment: deepbackfill credentials template (pure-web route). Copy to conf/deepbackfill.conf.json — or better: just run 'start deepbackfill' in the launcher shell; when credentials are missing/stale the service starts a QR session and the browser opens automatically (scan with mobile QQ; the service writes this file 0600 after live verification). The real file is gitignored and must NEVER be committed.
